superseded_scope: The no-further-revision closure is superseded only for appending normalized time remaining and one learning-rate-decay retraining attempt. The recorded P3-v3 result and diagnostics remain historical evidence.

disposition.result: P3-v3 is the final reported Gate 3 result for the Surveyor common task.

frozen_contract.immutability_statement: The route, disturbance envelope, terminal criterion, observation and action spaces, reward, timeout, training budget, and C3 thresholds remain frozen exactly as approved. The P3-v3 outcome does not authorize any revision.

retained_evidentiary_artifacts.purpose: Final Gate 3 measurement and per-seed evaluation
Checkpoint learning curve and late-training instability evidence
Full trajectories for the 12 final-leg episodes and closest-approach evidence
Per-leg reward decomposition and final-leg goal-transition analysis

limitations_basis.statement: The learned policy improved return and increasingly activated the final leg but did not complete the 2 m terminal approach on any of 50 fixed evaluation episodes.
supported_findings: Return passed its frozen C3 threshold, while terminal success failed.
Final-leg closest approaches were broadly distributed rather than clustered just outside 2 m.
The active final-waypoint observation updated correctly; stale-goal propagation was ruled out.
Late checkpoints showed non-monotonic return and zero success, supporting a training-stability limitation rather than a simple insufficient-budget conclusion.
The frozen 15-element observation contains no elapsed- or remaining-time signal; adding one would be a new contract revision, not a training-only change.
limitations_basis.paper_use: Retain these artifacts as the evidentiary basis for the Surveyor Gate 3 limitations paragraph.

closure_rule.default_next_action: Do not resume Surveyor Gate 3 calibration, contract editing, or retraining.
closure_rule.reopen_condition: Only a new, explicit user authorization that acknowledges this final disposition may reopen the work.
